one_liner: Switch-hitting Jose Ramirez had the most rows with recorded exit velocity in 2025: 986 in this twelve-hitter set.
three_things: The pull has 986 rows with recorded exit velocity from 2,699 pitches seen.
Contact quality without huge exit velo -- 84.0 mph average, .341 estimated wOBA on contact.
As a switch hitter he saw four-seam fastballs 26.7% of the time; 47.8% of pitches in the rulebook zone.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). Ramirez is a switch hitter, and this card aggregates both batter sides -- it does not split his left-handed and right-handed numbers. Exit-velocity figures use the 986 rows with recorded exit velocity. Estimated wOBA on contact uses rows with recorded model estimates, whose count is not reported here, and is a batted-ball model that ignores walks and strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Most in this set' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
